verdicts.reason: A: the title and subtitle are oversized and sit on top of the busy leaves and dropper bottle. The subtitle 'review' runs into the green bottle and is jammed against the right edge, and the beige brush stroke is cut off from the text and floats on its own. B: it has the same detached brush-stroke fragment and still puts text over the leaves, and its lighter brown lowers the contrast, but the subtitle fits inside the canvas without hitting the bottle, so it is slightly less broken.
